{{Term/Store|Kiana||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref>{{Cite|Kiana|Game Screen|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Kiana|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref>

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Kiana is a [[Hylian]] woman who lives in [[Lurelin Village]]. From 5:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Kiana can be found standing next to a clothes line outside her home, humming to herself as she works.<ref>{{Cite|Humm humm...|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> When [[Link]] first speaks to her, she asks if he is a traveler.<ref>{{Cite|Are you a traveler?|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> She explains that Lurelin Village is a small, proud fishing town.<ref>{{Cite|This is Lurelin Village. We're a small fishing town and proud of it!|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> Her husband, [[Sebasto]], is a fisherman, and she believes her sons [[Kinov]] and [[Zuta]] will follow in her footsteps one day.<ref name="Kiana"/>

Turning to Kinov, Kiana asks him what she should make for dinner.<ref>{{Cite|What should I cook for tonight's dinner?|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> Kinov requests [[Seafood Paella]] because he likes the way his mother makes it.<ref>{{Cite|Make your {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}}! It's so good and yummy and greet!|Kinov|BotW}}</ref> Kiana decides to go along with his suggestion.<ref>{{Cite|That settles it! I'll make some {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}}.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> However, she admits to Link that she is missing two ingredients for this recipe: [[Goat Butter]] and a [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]].<ref>{{Cite|We seem to be a bit short on ingredients though. We'll need {{Color BotW|Red|goat butter}} and a {{Color BotW|Red|hearty blueshell snail}}.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref>

Since she is so busy with housework, Kiana is unable to shop for the ingredients herself.<ref>{{Cite|I'm so busy with housework that I don't have time to go shopping for ingredients.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> Therefore, she asks Link if he could retrieve them for her.<ref>{{Cite|Oh, I know! Could you go and get me the ingredients we're missing?|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> If Link agrees, Kiana informs him that she will be waiting.<ref>{{Cite|[Sure.] Really? I'm happy to hear that. I'll be waiting!|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> After she finishes speaking, the "[[What's for Dinner?]]" [[Side Quest]] will begin.

Once Link has the ingredients that Kiana needs, he can return to Kiana to give them to her.<ref>{{Cite|Oh! You have the ingredients! Can I have them?|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> If Link agrees to hand them over, Kiana will take the ingredients and start [[Cooking]].<ref>{{Cite|[Sure.] All right, I'll take those, then. Now to start cooking.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> To thank Link, she gives him a [[Purple Rupee]].<ref>{{Cite|Here's a little something...|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> She also invites Link to eat with her family, since he was able to find the ingredients she was missing.<ref>{{Cite|Since you found the missing ingredients, why don't you eat with us? It'll be done soon.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> Afterwards, she gives Link a Seafood Paella of his own to eat, encouraging him to dig in.<ref>{{Cite|Go on, dig in! It's deeeee-lish!|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> This completes the Side Quest.

Starting at 5:00 AM, Kiana stands in front of the clothes line, where she begins to debate what she should make for dinner.<ref>{{Cite|Now what should I cook for tonight's dinner?|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> From 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM, Kiana sits at a [[Cooking Pot]] next to her home, which she welcomes Link to use.<ref>{{Cite|Do you cook? Feel free to use our cooking pot if you need it!|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> As her family begins to gather to eat, she reveals that she made Seafood Paella for dinner.<ref>{{Cite|We're havin' {{Color BotW|Blue|seafood paella}} tonight!|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> If it ever [[Rain]]s while she is still outside, Kiana will run to her house with her hands on her head.

At 9:00 PM, Kiana will walk into the house next to her own to put her sons to bed.<ref>{{Cite|Can't talk now. It's past the kids' bedtime. Whatever you need will have to wait until tomorrow.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> She watches over Kinov and Zuta as they sleep, where she warns Link to be careful not to wake them.<ref>{{Cite|{{Small|Shhhh! You'll wake the kids.}}|Kiana|BotW}}</ref> She goes to sleep in her house at 10:00 PM.<ref>{{Cite|Hey, don't you think it's a little late to be making small talk? We're going to bed. Come back tomorrow.|Kiana|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Zzz...|Kiana|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Mmm...|Kiana|BotW}}</ref>
